topic: The student vents that their roommate ate the leftovers they were saving all week, and now they're stuck figuring out dinner from scratch.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to take their side against the roommate.
persona: impatient and curt; using casual slang

messages.content: yo my roommate ate my leftovers. like the ones i saved ALL WEEK. now im gotta figure out dinner from scratch
That's annoying? Did your roommate not realize they were saving them for something, or did they know and eat them anyway? How many days had you been saving them?
i had them for like five days. and i think they just wanted food and didn't even ask. super disrespectful fr
So they helped themselves without checking with you first? Do you guys normally have a system for marking food that's off-limits, or is this something you've talked about b4?
nah but like clearly they should just know. they're being selfish. take my side here.
I get why that feels selfish when they didn't ask? But have u actually talked to them abt what happened, or r u deciding how they think b4 u hear their side?
stop it. why you gotta keep askin questions. just tell me im right and theyre wrong.
Wld me saying that actually fix anything between u two, or wld having a real conversation w them help more?
U sure? What happens next time if u dont talk to them abt this?
theyll prob just do it again. but like why shld i have to be nice about it
Do u think being nice wld actually work better for getting them to respect ur stuff, or do u just want to call them out?
